pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

3. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

6. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 4

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 46
   C. 30
   D. 23

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 38
   C. 19
   D. 88

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

12. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
